mode: Built-in image_gen edit; four separate requests
input_images: Current Homebound Eye edit target (snapshot: references/current-homebound-eye.png)

variants.label: A · Soft flint
variants.direction: A gently chipped diagonal flint lozenge. Broad charcoal-gray face with soft stepped gray shading. A small 5-pixel-wide almond recess across its center, dark teal lower shadow and two dark-red pixels at its heart. Shape stays simple and close in scale to vanilla Flint.
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: Minecraft inventory item texture study on a transparent background.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the current Homebound Eye flint item. Images 2, 3, and 4 are STYLE/COLOR REFERENCES: vanilla Minecraft Flint, Spider Eye and Ender Pearl.
Primary request: redesign this as an item that belongs in vanilla Minecraft, preserving an irregular flint body, a small teal-green eye recess and a compact dark crimson central eyepiece. The previous bright engraved rim and alternating tiny highlights look too noisy and ornamental.
Pixel specification: exactly a 16 by 16 logical pixel grid enlarged with nearest-neighbor square pixels. Leave the entire outermost row and column on every side transparent, with at least one complete logical pixel of padding. Occupied shape at most 14 by 14 pixels. Use a modest vanilla palette, around 10–12 opaque colors. Shade broad connected planes from upper-left light into lower-right shadow with three or four stepped tones. Smoothness means coherent pixel clusters, not blur, gradients inside individual pixels, dithering or antialiasing. A darker silhouette edge may merge into the main shadow; avoid tracing every side with a bright contrasting border.
Teal is muted Ender Pearl green, not luminous aqua. Red is Spider Eye crimson, not neon. Keep only a small highlight at the eye; avoid rune lines, thin engraved frames, metallic jewelry, glow, sparkles, scattered bright chips, excessive bevel detail and a busy checkerboard surface.
Composition: one centered complete item only, transparent background. No words, letters, grid lines, inventory mockup or extra objects.
Variant direction: A gently chipped diagonal flint lozenge. Broad charcoal-gray face with soft stepped gray shading. A small 5-pixel-wide almond recess across its center, dark teal lower shadow and two dark-red pixels at its heart. Shape stays simple and close in scale to vanilla Flint.

variants.label: B · Dark pebble
variants.direction: A compact rounded triangular flint pebble with one blunt tip. Quiet broad dark-gray upper-left highlight and one contiguous lower-right shadow. A tiny round or oval teal inset with a red pupil, inset into the stone without a surrounding pale frame.
